title: resolve_secret_uri duplicated across transit and reader main.rs
description: crates/transit/src/main.rs lines 214-244 and crates/reader/src/main.rs lines 198-228 contain identical async fn resolve_secret_uri() implementations. The transit copy has an explicit NOTE comment: 'An identical copy of this function exists in crates/reader/src/main.rs. If you change the logic here, change it there too.' This is a textbook maintenance trap: a security-relevant function (secret retrieval, UTF-8 validation, process::exit on failure) that lives in two places. A contributor who fixes a bug or adds a new secretx backend type in one copy will not notice the comment, and the other copy silently diverges. The function belongs in stoa_core or a shared secretx-utils crate accessible to both binaries. Maintenance consequence: any security fix to secret resolution logic must be applied twice; the NOTE comment will be missed in code review.
